verification_summary.new_function_need: Independently confirmed via reading lib/letflow/audit.ex in full: only append_multi/4, insert_entry/3, verify_chain/2, and struct_state/2 exist -- no read/list function of any kind. Confirmed routers/audit.ex's own moduledoc states 'this module performs no Repo call of any kind' (INV-RT-1), matching admin_services.ex-style invariants project-wide, so a filtered/paginated list genuinely cannot be built inline in the router. Confirmed the cited ServiceCatalog.list_all/1 precedent (lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex ~L369-387) matches the design's claimed shape: own list_params()-equivalent input, own cursor-prefix constant ("SCA:" vs "SC:"), page_size+1-fetch/drop-extra-row idiom, and Repo.all(query) with no tenant filter of its own (ServiceCatalog is not tenant-scoped the way Audit.Entry is). The new Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1 is genuinely required, not a convenience.
verification_summary.payload_removal_safety: Read web/src/api/audit.ts in full: RawAuditEntry (L26-35) declares exactly eight fields (audit_id, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp, before_state, after_state) -- no payload field. Grepped 'payload' and '\.payload' across web/src/pages/admin/AuditLogPage.tsx and web/src/ entirely: zero matches. Removal is confirmed safe independently, not by trusting the design doc's own grep claims.
verification_summary.current_router_match: Read lib/letflow/routers/audit.ex in full: moduledoc's stated caveats (resource_type constant "instance", before_state/after_state always null, payload as a Letflow addition), EventStore.read_global/1 usage, the payload field in audit_item/1, and all eight filter params (cursor, page_size, from, to, actor_id, resource_id, resource_type, pipeline_run_id) all match the design's description of the current state exactly.
verification_summary.index_backing: Read priv/repo/migrations/20260830020001_create_audit_entries_tenant_scoped.exs directly: confirms all three indexes the design cites exist verbatim -- (timestamp desc, id desc), (actor_id, timestamp desc, id desc), (resource_type, resource_id, timestamp desc, id desc). No new migration is needed for this requirement's filter shapes.
verification_summary.resource_type_filter: Confirmed unsupported_resource_type?/1 (routers/audit.ex L211-214) currently treats any value other than nil/""/"instance" as unsupported, short-circuiting to an empty page with no query issued -- a no-op filter. Design correctly specifies deleting this function and its call site, replacing it with a real optional equality filter (resource_type == ^resource_type when present) backed by the confirmed index #3.
verification_summary.authorization_unchanged: Grepped lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex: endpoint_policy_key("GET", "/audit") returns :AuditRead (L282), unchanged. No edit to this file is in scope.
verification_summary.moduledoc_rewrite_precision: Design section 5 names the exact lines to remove (the 'Served from the event store' section, L14-37; the resource_type 'not supported' framing in the filter-disposition table) and prescribes concrete replacement content (naming Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1 as the new delegate, restating what before_state/after_state/resource_type now do) -- no 'always null'/'constant resource_type' language survives, and no TBD/deferral language anywhere in the design.
verification_summary.ac_cross_check: All 9 REQ-196 acceptance criteria (docs/requirements.yaml L10651-10659) read directly and cross-checked against the design's section 0 traceability table -- every AC maps to a concrete design element (AC1/AC2 -> sections 1/2.1; AC3 -> section 3; AC4 -> sections 2/2.2; AC5 -> section 6; AC6 -> section 7; AC7 -> section 5; AC8 -> section 9 non-goals; AC9 is ELIXIR-DEV/TEST-RUNNER's own execution gate).
verification_summary.no_implementation_code: Grepped the design doc for defmodule, ^\s*def , and Ecto pipe-chain bodies (|> where(, |> Repo., Repo.all(query) -- the only match for the last pattern is prose inside backticks in section 7 describing runtime semantics, not a code fence. All six fenced blocks (L43-53 @type, L72-76 @spec, L173-183 response envelope shape) contain only type declarations and a plain map/comment sketch, no executable function bodies. task.description: Implement REQ-196 strictly per the APPROVED design at lib/letflow/design/req196-audit-route.md (passed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, see verification_summary above). Add Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1 (design section 1) to lib/letflow/audit.ex: accepts the list_params() shape (page_size, optional pre-decoded cursor seek pair, from, to, actor_id, resource_id, resource_type), queries Letflow.Audit.Entry with only-when-present predicates (section 1.3's table), orders by timestamp desc/id desc, uses the page_size+1/drop-extra-row has_more idiom, and is prefix-scoped. Repoint lib/letflow/routers/audit.ex's handle_list/1 from Letflow.EventStore.read_global/1 to Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1: delete unsupported_resource_type?/1 and its call site entirely (resource_type becomes a real optional equality filter), update audit_item/1's field mapping per section 2.1 (id->audit_id rename retained, resource_type/before_state/after_state now real columns, payload field removed entirely), update next_cursor/2 to mint over the (timestamp, id) seek pair instead of global_seq. Rewrite the moduledoc per section 5: remove the 'Served from the event store, not an audit-entry table' section and the resource_type 'not supported' framing; state that GET /audit now reads from Letflow.Audit.list_entries/1 backed by REQ-195's audit_entries table, and that resource_type/before_state/after_state now carry real per-row values. Do NOT touch lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex, lib/letflow/audit/entry.ex's schema, Letflow.Audit's append_multi/4/insert_entry/3/verify_chain/2, or anything under web/. Resolve OQ-1 (whether :invalid_resource_id is reachable) and OQ-2 (cursor-decode placement) as documented in the design's section 8 -- both are open style/dead-code judgment calls, not correctness blockers.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/audit returns entries sourced from audit_entries, with before_state and after_state carrying real non-null values for an operation that changed state -- the direct inverse of the always-null behaviour audit.ex's moduledoc records today, asserted by a test that would have failed before this requirement
resource_type in the response varies by resource kind rather than being the constant "instance", demonstrated by a response containing at least two different resource_type values
the resource_type query parameter filters: a request filtering to one resource kind returns only entries of that kind, and omitting it returns all kinds

the response envelope still matches web/src/api/audit.ts's RawAuditPage and RawAuditEntry field-for-field, so web/src/pages/admin/AuditLogPage.tsx continues to render without a change under web/ -- asserted field by field
the route still requires :AuditRead and still returns 403 without it, using REQ-069's existing matrix with no change to lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex (confirmed by git diff)
a caller from one tenant does not receive another tenant's audit entries
lib/letflow/routers/audit.ex's moduledoc no longer states that before_state and after_state are always null or that resource_type is a constant, and instead describes the store it now reads from
no file under web/ is added or modified, confirmed by git diff --stat scoped to this requirement's commits
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
